prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the sixteen heading frames of a boss gun turret — a round armoured mount, sixteen copies, barrel direction the only difference, ark.

Design identity to keep exactly — a circular armoured gun mount of the ARK's bone-and-rust scrap: a pale bone disc (#b8b09a) lit upper-left, darker bone body (#7a7462) elsewhere, rimmed by rust-brown armour plating (#7a4a30) with riveted seams, a short thick gunmetal barrel (#5a5448) from the centre to the rim on ONE side, capped by a cold cyan energy muzzle (#6ad8e0), 1-px near-black outline (#05090c). The mount is ROUND and nearly as tall as wide in every frame — the disc dominates, the barrel is SHORT (it must not stretch the silhouette).

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 16 square cells laid out as 4 ROWS OF 4 (4-column by 4-row grid) — every cell holding exactly ONE mount. Reading order left-right then top-bottom:
  cell 1 = barrel heading 0.0° (E )
  cell 2 = barrel heading 22.5° (ESE )
  cell 3 = barrel heading 45.0° (SE-south-east )
  cell 4 = barrel heading 67.5° (SSE )
  cell 5 = barrel heading 90.0° (S )
  cell 6 = barrel heading 112.5° (SSW )
  cell 7 = barrel heading 135.0° (SW-south-west )
  cell 8 = barrel heading 157.5° (WSW )
  cell 9 = barrel heading 180.0° (W )
  cell 10 = barrel heading 202.5° (WNW )
  cell 11 = barrel heading 225.0° (NW-north-west )
  cell 12 = barrel heading 247.5° (NNW )
  cell 13 = barrel heading 270.0° (N )
  cell 14 = barrel heading 292.5° (NNE )
  cell 15 = barrel heading 315.0° (NE-north-east )
  cell 16 = barrel heading 337.5° (ENE )
- HEADING LAW: heading = cell index k × 22.5° measured CLOCKWISE ON SCREEN from +x (cell 1 = 0° points RIGHT, cell 5 = 90° straight DOWN, cell 9 = 180° LEFT, cell 13 = 270° UP). The mount body is IDENTICAL in all 16 cells — same size, dead-centre; ONLY the barrel rotates one step per cell.
- THE SIXTEEN MOUNTS ARE SIXTEEN ISOLATED GAME ICONS. NOTHING connects them: no shared armour band, no plating row, no wall, no touching or overlapping rims. Each mount is a TINY stamp: the disc is about 45 px wide and the SHORT stub barrel stops AT the disc rim — no pixel of any mount further than 35 px from its cell's exact centre; leave about 90 px of flat green above AND below every mount. ALL 16 mounts together cover barely 8% of the sheet; flat green covers the rest, unbroken between every pair of neighbours. If any band of ink crosses a cell border, the sheet is ruined. Every mount's whole silhouette (disc plus barrel) lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.40:1 — round, never an elongated banner.
- Each mount sits at the exact centre of its own cell with at least 90 px of unbroken flat #51e018 between it and every cell edge, above and below included; clean flat gutters everywhere; no subject may touch or cross a cell edge.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 1024×1024 px: produce EXACTLY 16 subject cells and nothing else.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere — the cell list above is ordering instructions only, never drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible at that low resolution (rivets, panel seams, a shaded rim ramp), crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, four-to-six step shading lit from the top-left, clean saturated colours, 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
